Equation solving for the Epsilon symbolic math library. Exact solutions of equations in one unknown: polynomial and rational equations, with cubics and quartics in radicals; equations with roots of the unknown, raised to powers with the solutions that adds kept out; exponentials, logarithms, powers…

The PostgreSQL layer of BCC Privacy: the privacy columns, column comments, constraints, the catalogue and the package tables, generated from the data classes and processes. PrivacySql.Script(...) serves migrators other than EF Core.

The wire contract between Gleanvolt and an external data provider (#386): the handshake, the per-kind hub and client interfaces and their data. No dependencies. MIT, so a provider can be written under any licence.

Write an external data provider for Gleanvolt (#386): connects to Gleanvolt over SignalR, says hello after every reconnect, backs off after a refusal, and answers the host's requests. A provider is an ordinary worker service. MIT, so a provider can be written under any licence.

Test a Gleanvolt charger plugin without Gleanvolt (#439): a charger hub on a loopback port that the plugin connects to with the ordinary SDK. Read the charger, send it commands, and check every reading by the contract's rules. For a plugin on Gleanvolt.Chargers.Hosting, a harness and a fake Modbus…

Write a Gleanvolt charger plugin in a few files: the host, the page Gleanvolt frames, the settings, a LAN search and a recording for testers, on the Gleanvolt provider SDK. The plugin implements its charger. MIT.

A Modbus TCP client that keeps its connection healthy (#439): one request at a time, spaced, a teardown after any failed exchange, late replies read past, and a reconnect backoff for gateways that recover slowly. What Gleanvolt and its charger plugins talk to Modbus devices with. MIT.
